rules: Do not treat option codes as ordinal scores.
Never infer missing answers or treat missing as none.
Never infer stress, menstrual history or sunlight exposure from this export.
Keep questionnaire measurements separate from IHR and Bio-AI.
Do not infer model features or causal contributions.
Goals are preferences, not risk factors.
For differential blood counts, confirm percent versus absolute units; confirm hormone fraction and fasting status.
Do not interpret reported lab-like entries without appropriate reference and provenance.
Use condition-specific selection for family history, diagnosis and medication; do not treat them as equivalent.
